title: Run cross-container coherence review before accepting a container as complete
description:
Runs a coherence review across sub-strategic containers before accepting any single one of them as complete, checking naming, style, and interface consistency at the strategic tier — the one-tier-up analogue of the per-issue holistic coherence review `jit-execution-lead` already runs on its own workers.

## Background

`jit-execution-lead`'s Tier 3 holistic coherence review (`references/lead-review-protocol.md`) checks cross-issue naming, style, and interface consistency before accepting a dispatched worker's output, and its Tier 2.5 stale-narrative sweep greps for forward-looking references left stale by newly landed work. The equivalent is needed one tier up: cross-container naming, style, and interface consistency, plus a stale-forward-reference sweep across container-level artifacts (design docs, plan docs, completion reports), before accepting a whole container — not a single issue — as done.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Before a sub-strategic container is marked complete, a review compares its naming, conventions, and produced interfaces (APIs, data structures, shared documents) against every other sub-strategic container already accepted under the same strategic-tier parent, and records a PASS/FAIL verdict with specific findings.
- [hard] REQ-02: The review includes a sweep for stale forward-looking references (for example "planned", "future work", "once X lands") left in documentation or artifacts by containers that have since completed, analogous to the stale-narrative sweep `jit-execution-lead` runs per issue.
- [hard] REQ-03: A FAIL verdict blocks acceptance of the container as complete until every finding is resolved; the review never silently downgrades a FAIL to a pass.
- [hard] REQ-04: The review protocol is documented as skill prose (a `references/` file analogous to `references/lead-review-protocol.md`) in the cc-sdd/superpowers register — terse imperative voice, explicit tiers and verdict format — following the exemplars at `../jit-research/cc-sdd/tools/cc-sdd/templates/agents/claude-code-skills/skills/kiro-spec-design/SKILL.md`, `../jit-research/superpowers/skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md`, and `../jit-research/superpowers/skills/executing-plans/SKILL.md`.

## Notes

Reviews containers that have already been dispatched and report completion; does not itself dispatch or drive execution of any container.
